topic: How to help your teen land their first dog walking client this week
caption:
Most teens are one handwritten note away from their first paying client.

Have your teen write a short intro, name a fair rate ($15/hour is standard to start), and drop it in 10 neighbors' mailboxes this week.

That small action builds more confidence than a hundred hours of scrolling.
